prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop application concept, 1536x864 landscape
Primary request: redesign the complete CodeHead software-factory workspace into a highly crafted, premium interactive product screen. This is a coherent application screen, not a poster or marketing page.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing application. Preserve ONLY its seven robot identities and its exact brand mark; replace its cheap flat environment, checkerboard room layout and generic UI. Image 2 is the human-provided craft reference for architectural depth, convincing decor, light and atmosphere; do not replace the identities from Image 1.
Composition: a refined narrow charcoal application header at the top, a small vertical tool rail at far left, one elegant compact context drawer at right, a slim role dock below. A large isometric architectural diorama occupies 80 percent of the viewport and is the visual focus. Controls look like a designed professional editor with clear hierarchy, quiet spacing and tactile material boundaries.
Environment: a connected ten-zone AI engineering atelier, open cutaway rooms around a sculptural central telemetry hub. Build rooms with meaningful architecture and circulation rather than ten identical rectangles. Mix curved glass partitions, chamfered structural pillars, elevated walkways, recessed cable channels, ribbed wall panels, detailed server cabinetry, perforated ventilation, layered desks, screen mounts, small storage and artfully placed indoor plants. Rich believable scale, intentional composition.
Style: high-end stylized 3D architectural visualization with authored design detail and restrained playful character, miniature studio diorama. Keep the robots from Image 1 and their proportions/appearance; they are stationary.
Materials: satin graphite anodized metal, slightly worn warm timber, translucent tinted glass, textured floor panels, ceramic planters, soft rubber details, precise bevels and contact shadows. Surface texture is subtle and physically convincing.
Lighting: deep blue night, warm amber task lamps, cool cyan equipment light, soft indirect bounce, gentle illuminated glass, dimensional shadows, tasteful atmosphere. The whole scene remains readable. No crude rainbow glow or black crushed shadows.
Palette: graphite and midnight blue dominate; electric cyan and warm orange accents. Greenery and timber act as natural material colors.
Text: preserve the supplied brand image. Sparse UI text only: "CodeHead", "Проект", "Задачи", "Офлайн". Avoid permanent labels over every room and robot.
Truth: an AI-generated concept of a future visual redesign, not proof of working agents. No charts claiming token usage, costs, completions or active execution.
Avoid: cheap low-poly cubes, empty grey warehouse, repeated generic panels, giant sidebars, text clutter, flat primitive decor, desktop monitor mockup frame, marketing claims, watermarks.
